name: The Main Control Room

npcs.name: Dr. Elias Voss
dialogue: I am Dr. Elias Voss, the World Engine's creator. I wanted to control disasters.
Instead, I pushed the machine past its limits and made every warning worse.
The research log, control key, and backup cell can help your team shut it down.
after_dialogue: I will answer for what I did. Please stabilize the core and protect the people first.

npcs.name: Engr. Paolo Santos
dialogue: I am Engr. Paolo Santos. The key and backup cell are ready, but the core is unstable.
We need to evacuate the staff, isolate the power, and follow the shutdown checklist.
after_dialogue: The personnel route is open. Choose the shutdown plan that protects people and emergency systems.

choice.prompt: How should we stop the World Engine?

options.result: The team stabilizes the core and protects emergency systems before shutdown.
options.mascot: Secure people and preserve emergency support before operating unstable equipment.
options.consequence: The team stabilized and isolated the core, preserved emergency systems, then shut the machine down.

options.result: The core stops, but the team loses some system support and evidence.
options.mascot: An emergency stop may prevent greater danger, but incomplete checks carry a cost.
options.consequence: The team used the emergency stop before stabilizing every system.

options.result: The team withdraws, but the unstable machine continues operating.
options.mascot: Protecting people matters, but leaving the source active keeps the danger growing.
options.consequence: The team withdrew without stopping the World Engine.

npcs.name: Dr. Mira Santos
dialogue: I am Dr. Mira Santos. I hurt my leg during the evacuation, but I can still help the team.
Please bring the first-aid kit, then help me reach the personnel exit.
after_dialogue: Thank you. I can walk with you to the evacuation point now.
rescue_dialogue: I cannot walk safely with my injured leg. Bring the first-aid kit, then carry me to inland high ground.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. Please carry me to inland high ground.
npcs.rescue_hint: Collect the first-aid kit, then speak with Dr. Mira Santos again.

quests.title: Read Dr. Voss’s final research log
Secure the World Engine control key
Hear Dr. Voss explain the failure
Give Dr. Mira Santos first aid
Evacuate personnel to the safe point

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety.

quests.rescue_pilar: Find Dr. Mira Santos and give her the radio so she can call the response team.
quests.community: Find Engr. Paolo Santos and press E.
quests.evacuate: Reach the marked inland safe zone.
quests.cover: When shaking starts, get under the sturdy table in the green cover field.

lessons: Follow the response leader’s instructions. Protect people first, preserve backup systems, and keep clear of unstable equipment.

quiz.question: What makes a shutdown plan safer during a complex emergency?
options: Coordinate the team, protect people, and preserve emergency systems
quiz.explanation: Coordination and protecting people and emergency systems reduce risk during the shutdown.

briefing: Inside the Main Control Room, all eight hazards are active. Evacuate anyone still inside, then decide whether to stabilize the World Engine or abandon the shutdown attempt.
story_clue: The community’s rescues, evidence, supplies, and earlier decisions shape the final choice.
